about_short_description.short_description: SkyStruct is a Construction ERP Software that helps to streamline projects and drive success across all construction areas.

product.name: SkyStruct Construction ERP Software
product.description: An integrated software platform for managing all phases of construction projects, including resource planning, cost control, and stakeholder communication.

product.name: Construction Phases Management
product.description: A module to assign, prioritize, and track every phase of a construction project systematically to ensure project completion.

product.name: Safety & Security Management
product.description: A system to maintain safety standards and secure project objectives through integrated security measures.

product.name: Financial Management
product.description: A financial control system to manage budgets, payments, and cost tracking throughout construction projects.

product.name: Ease of Procurement
product.description: Tools and processes to streamline procurement activities and ensure timely availability of materials and services.

product.name: Workforce Management
product.description: A system to manage labor resources, including time attendance, role assignments, and workforce tracking.
